fields.description: Physical 3D models of the museum, 1 for each of their 3 floors.  click thru for more: Per the zoom with Mary, the purpose is to discuss with their artists about placement of art and site-specific installations. We discussed building this from foam core and printing the walls with their rashes instead of trying to fab those separately (imagine making electrical outlets at 1/12 scale).  We will likely need to 3d print the chairs and water fountains.  Doors do not need to open.  Mary will ask the designers who drew the sketchup files to export STP format.  I am concerned that we will lose the surface textures but let's wait and see how that goes.  Most of the wall rash is actually modeled so we should be able to get an image off it anyway. We discussed sizing it at 1:12 which is common, but my calculations for the 2nd floor, which is the largest, put that at a model size of 115" x 70" which is too big.  Scaling at 1:20 puts it at 70" x 42" which seems more reasonable.  That gives 53" x 34" for the 1st floor and 55" x 30" for the third.
